name: Summer Winds

targets.description: your allies (healed) and hostile Undead (hurt) in the Cone

summary: 15-foot Cone of light and wind: your allies in it regain 2d6 Hit Points, and hostile Undead make a Constitution save or take 2d6 Radiant (half on a success).
text: You loose a blast of light and wind in a 15-foot Cone from yourself. Your allies in the Cone regain 2d6 Hit Points. Each Undead in the Cone that is hostile to you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 Radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success. An allied Undead (a Graveborn or Relicborn hero, say) is healed, not hurt, because it is not hostile. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: both the damage and the healing increase by 2d6 for each slot level above 2.
